text:
maria (People Ops): Heads up: manager handback opens Monday 2024-05-06 09:00 PT. Please do not start signoffs before youve read the New Manager Checklist.
lee (Eng Manager): New Manager Checklist link?
maria (People Ops): https://intra/redwood/people-ops/new-manager-checklist — short version: verify org roles, attach peer feedback (see privacy rules), and flag any "conflict of interest" cases in the tracker.
anya (Recruiting): Reminder: if you hired someone in the cycle (start date after 2024-02-15) mark them as "new-hire" in the tracker so they get the condensed calibration slot.
ocean (IC): Quick Q: what counts as a conflict of interest? My manager reviewed someone they mentored at a prior company.
todd (People Ops): Conflicts = prior managerial relationship in last 18 months, direct financial ties, or if the manager is a listed reference. Mark on the COI column and include short note. COI triggers an alternate reviewer assignment.
lee (Eng Manager): Who assigns the alternate reviewer?
maria (People Ops): People Ops will assign an alternate reviewer or panel reviewer depending on team size. If you disagree with assignment, escalate to people-ops@redwood.com within 24h.
notify-bot: Action required: signups for calibration facilitators close Fri 2024-05-10 16:00 PT.
ocean (IC): For peer feedback attachments: are screenshots allowed? Some feedback is in Slack threads.
todd (People Ops): Screenshots okay if redacted for personal data. Preferred: paste the message thread into a doc and remove PII. Attach or link and confirm viewer access.
lee (Eng Manager): Template request: can we get a short justification template for promotion asks?
maria (People Ops): Use this 3-line template in the packet: 1) Contribution summary (1 sentence) 2) Evidence (2 bullets) 3) Ask & suggested level. We'll include it in the calibration packet.
ocean (IC): Is anonymous upward feedback included in calibration?
todd (People Ops): Anonymous upward is visible to People Ops and the calibration chair only. We do not share raw anonymous responses with managers; any signal that materially affects rating will be investigated and summarized.
anya (Recruiting): New hire callouts: managers, please confirm start dates in the tracker by Tue 2024-05-07 so we can exclude probationary hires from promotion consideration where applicable.
lee (Eng Manager): Can managers swap calibration slots between teams? I may need a morning slot.
maria (People Ops): Yes — swaps allowed if both managers agree and you update the calendar title to include "calibration: swapped". Keep People Ops in the loop.
notify-bot: Export ready: s3://redwood-ops/reports/review_cycle_2024/status.csv
ocean (IC): Any CLI for the export?
todd (People Ops): Example: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ops/reports/review_cycle_2024/status.csv ./status.csv --profile ops-readonly
cat status.csv | grep ",missing_self_assessment," > missing.csv
```
lee (Eng Manager): If calibration panel changes a rating, do I need to change my manager note?
maria (People Ops): Yes please update the manager rationale in Workday within 48h of the panel decision. We keep an audit trail.
ocean (IC): What's the promo approval flow? Director signoff? Compensation?
todd (People Ops): Promotion requires two manager-level approvals (manager + director) and compensation validation. Compensation changes are processed after calibration week; People Ops will share ETA per team.
anya (Recruiting): Small ops ask: can People Ops tag new hires in the tracker with "onboarding: incomplete" to prevent calendar invites for calibration?
maria (People Ops): We can. DM me a short list.
lee (Eng Manager): Are there manager training drop-ins for calibration best practices?
maria (People Ops): Yes 10-minute live drop-ins tomorrow 09:30 PT and 16:00 PT. Recordings will be posted to the checklist page.
notify-bot: Reminder: final ratings freeze at 23:59 PT on 2024-05-14. After freeze, only People Ops can update records.
ocean (IC): If a manager believes calibration made an error, what's the appeals window?
todd (People Ops): Managers have 72 hours after the freeze to submit an appeal with concrete evidence. Appeals go to the calibration chair and people-ops; decisions are final after chair review.
lee (Eng Manager): Thanks for clarifying. Will share the calibration packet and COI notes with my skip-level before the panel.
maria (People Ops): Great. I'll push the updated manager checklist and a one-page "what to include" PDF to the drive by EOD. Ping us for exceptions. :white_check_mark:
